Description: This bit is used to set the high byte of the register before starting a Resume command. The Host Driver shall store the value of this register when the data transfer is suspended and set it back to a Suspend command until storing a Resume command. The value of this register is decremented by 1 when the data transfer is suspended. Refer to Preset Count register in 0.

This bit is used to set the low byte of the register before starting a Resume command. The Host Driver shall store the value of this register when the data transfer is suspended and set it back to a Suspend command until storing a Resume command. The value of this register is decremented by 1 when the data transfer is suspended. Refer to Preset Count register in 0.

This bit is set when multiple block transfer commands using DAT line are issued to card. Setting this bit to 1 to enable Auto CMD12 function to stop a multiple block data transfer. The SD Host Driver shall set this bit to 0 for all other commands.

This bit is used to enable the Block Count register. The bit is set to 1 by the Host Driver to enable this function. If this bit is set to 0, the SD Host Controller shall ignore the value set in the all other commands.
